selection_method: human-reviewed stable spans from the supplied promotional walkthrough, cross-checked against the supplied room photos

segments.visual_match: Dining table and living seating match the supplied living/dining photos.
Kitchen island, cabinets, and appliances match the supplied kitchen photos.
Entry hall and view toward the living area match the supplied lobby photos.
Artwork, sofa, shelving, and blue chair match the supplied family lounge photos.
Double vanity and marble wall match the supplied master bathroom photo.
Bedroom bed wall and furnishings are consistent with the master suite shown in the supplied photos.
Wardrobe and dressing area are consistent with the supplied walk-in closet reference photo.
Bed, round mirror, and wall-mounted television match one supplied third-bedroom photo.
Dark vanity, shower, and window match the supplied third-bedroom bathroom photo.
Yellow accent pillow, bed, and wall decor match the supplied fourth-bedroom photos.
Beige marble vanity and shower match the supplied fourth-bedroom bathroom photo.

limitations: These are cropped intervals from a promotional video, not independent room recordings; titles and room labels are inferred from visual matching.
Promotional edits, camera motion, overlays, and crossfades can reduce SfM registration; interval boundaries deliberately avoid obvious transitions.
Video-only sparse models have arbitrary scale and do not provide measured room geometry, door widths, or metric room placement.
The fourth-bedroom ensuite video interval is identified by its visual match to the supplied bathroom photo; its association to the labeled room is not independently surveyed.
